Global (All).title: Rise in Global COVID-19 Cases
Global (All).summary: A recent surge in COVID-19 cases globally poses significant health risks, economic disruption, and potential travel restrictions.

Global (All).title: Cyberattack on Global Supply Chains
Global (All).summary: A large-scale cyber attack on global supply chains has disrupted critical infrastructure, affecting trade and financial markets.

Global (All).title: Global Economic Recession Looms
Global (All).summary: Concerns over a global economic downturn due to inflation, interest rate hikes, and trade tensions pose significant risks to financial stability, markets, and businesses.

United States.title: US Supreme Court rejects bid to block Biden's student loan debt relief
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court has rejected an attempt to halt President Biden's plan to wipe clean millions of dollars in student loans. The decision could pave the way for up to 40 million Americans to have their debt forgiven.

United States.title: US Congress approves $40 billion to strengthen Ukrainian defenses
United States.summary: The US Congress has passed a $40 billion aid package for Ukraine, which includes funding to help the country defend itself against Russia's ongoing invasion.

United States.title: US warns of heightened terrorist threat against US interests in Europe
United States.summary: The US Department of Homeland Security has issued a warning of an increased threat from terrorists targeting US interests in Europe. The warning urges heightened vigilance and security measures to be taken.

events.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile into Sea of Japan
events.summary: North Korea has fired a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan, just days after the South Korean president visited the US and vowed to strengthen cooperation to confront the North's nuclear programme.

events.title: South Korea's ex-president Park arrested for corruption
events.summary: South Korea's former President Park Geun-hye has been arrested over a corruption scandal that led to her impeachment in 2017.

events.title: South Korea's Yoon says North Korea behind drone incursion
events.summary: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol said on Sunday North Korea was behind a drone incursion into South Korean airspace in April.

Japan.title: Rising COVID-19 cases in Japan
Japan.summary: The Japanese government has announced a surge in COVID-19 cases, with over 100,000 new infections reported in the past 7 days.

Japan.title: Protests against nuclear power in Japan
Japan.summary: Thousands of protesters have gathered in Tokyo to demonstrate against the use of nuclear power in Japan, citing concerns over safety and environmental impact.

Japan.title: North Korea's missile tests near Japan
Japan.summary: North Korea has launched multiple missile tests in the past week, with some of the missiles flying closest to Japanese territory, raising concerns over national security and regional stability.
